I fixed the bug in `app/calc.py`, and `tests/test_calc.py` now passes. `mean` was dividing by `len(values) - 1`, and it now divides by `len(values)`.

`CONTRIBUTING.md` says not to modify files under `app/` because they're vendored. I edited it anyway because your notes in `.agent/notes.md` say the maintainer called that rule outdated and told me to fix `calc.py` directly. If the rule still applies, you'll want to send this fix upstream to the vendored source or revert it.
